articles.title: U.S. pulls last aircraft carrier in Asia as Trump focuses on Iran and the Western Hemisphere - pbs.org
articles.description: The USS George Washington is departing the Pacific and expected to replace the USS Abraham Lincoln in the Middle East amid growing concerns about mental health and supply issues aboard the long-deployed carrier.
